title: Exceptional system FiniteAdjoint
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], a compactification $c=(j,p)$ of $f:X\to Y$, a finite coefficient field $E$ and a positive ell-power level $n+1$. Finite exceptional adjunction data consist of preservation of finite $D_{ctf}$ by the actual compact-support functor of [det-sp-reduction-exceptional], a right adjoint $G_{E,n}$ on those full subcategories, its adjunction, and its ordinary-etale counit-preserving realization [det-sp-reduction-exceptional]. No existence assertion is part of this definition.
